description: มุน 2026-08-03 (ฟีม, Figma 636:19061 + get_motion_context): the ดวงสมพงศ์ hero has 6 floating corner ELEMENT sprites (ไฟ/ไม้/น้ำ/ดิน/ทอง) that AST/console can't see fail. Bug-class the pixels+motion own: (1) ASSET-FIDELITY — each sprite className points at a committed PNG (public/images/v2/compat/*.png, Figma-exact export); a wrong path paints nothing (naturalWidth>0 for all 6). (2) DECORATION — the sprite layer is aria-hidden + pointer-events-none + z BELOW content, and is CLIPPED by the frame (overflow-hidden) so it never pushes the page sideways (0 overflow-x @393/360/320). (3) MOTION — the float (2s loop: y 0→-7, scale 1.03, rotate base±2°, ease cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1), per get_motion_context) must RUN normally but STOP under prefers-reduced-motion. The base rotation lives OUTSIDE the @keyframes so removing the animation falls back to the exact static base, not a snap to 0deg. verify-the-instrument: the reduce=0 check is only meaningful because the SAME getAnimations probe reads ≥6 with motion on (negative-control, run first). Teeth-proven (run-compat-sprites.ts, 11/11): mut-sprite-missing (a sprite → 404) → naturalWidth 0 → fidelity CAUGHT; mut-motion-runs-under-reduce (force animation on under reduce = dropped guard) → getAnimations≥6 → motion CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual/motion (naturalWidth + computed pointer-events/aria + getAnimations + geometry). Pixel-verified @393 on the real route vs Figma 636:19061 (sprites flank the donut, clipped at edges). Did NOT touch pages/matching or constants/api/api-user-matching (git diff 0).
